Copy is a separate view of the same ads: $502,224.56 matched tracked copy names or copy angles. Copy and concept totals should not be added to the static/video totals. Winner summaries use the downloaded strategist statuses; blank statuses are excluded from win-rate calculations.

4 included creatives have at least one unavailable conversion metric. A dash means unavailable or an undefined ratio; missing values are never treated as a confirmed zero.

The historical Meta tab supplies February 11–April 13, 2026. The current Meta and Hyros tabs supply April 14 through the reporting end date shown above. The selected source intervals are validated as adjacent and non-overlapping.

Spend, impressions, clicks, video views and previews use both Meta raw tabs. Funnel outcomes use the hidden Meta tab through April 13 and the explicit Hyros columns afterward: New Leads, MQL, Contacts, SQLs and Signed Cases. Hyros Cost and the Total row are not added to Meta spend or creative totals.

The downloaded Stage: Signed Case metric supersedes the earlier API lead-stage filter, which returned different counts. The export does not identify its attribution model, so First Click is not assumed.

Creatives with Meta spend but no applicable outcome row remain visible with unavailable outcomes. Concept counts marked * are recorded subtotals; cost-per-result remains unavailable when outcomes are incomplete.
